body:
CHIEF REVIEW — informed comment only; no adoption, implementation authority, reservation, or merge decision.

Verdict: the central diagnosis and most of the scientific boundary are sound, but docs/plans/2026-09-01-recall-construction-prd.md is not adoption-ready in its current bytes.

1. BLOCKING DURABILITY ERROR — R3.1 is the superseded broad sentence. The file still says "A witness minted by the resolver" and only narrows it later in the same line. The controlling board amendment and independently reconstructed byte-court require the direct conformance-only wording: the resolver may mint the conformance/replay witness only; it cannot mint provider or adjudicator authenticity. This matters because the broad subject makes construction authority sound resolver-mintable before the qualifier repairs it. The file's promise to be self-contained is therefore not met.

2. BLOCKING FACTUAL ERROR — R11.7 says shipped compiler output is unaffected. On current main d147b596 I ran a new falsifier in an isolated git archive. It permuted only two evidence records inside one AgentProposal. The emitted ClaimId key set stayed equal, but compilation fingerprints changed from fc2cc1d9330ab8ca4320c80f08c228141b62f1102af384527895e7d0da0a081f to 6597ef2637b111e75d5b5d20ccb265e54ec8dd8913fe52cf51b52fde9b661951. CompilerSuite result: 22 passed, this one expected invariant failed, 23 total. Source mechanism: canonicalBundle sorts proposals by renderProposal, whose comparison key sorts evidence renderings, but it does not reorder AgentProposal.evidence; Resolver.collect preserves within-proposal order; materialize preserves it into ClaimMeta; renderClaimMeta fingerprints that order. The existing permutation court reverses proposals, not evidence within one proposal. R11 is therefore a live shipped-output defect, not only a latent next-consumer hazard.

3. CONTRACT COMPLETENESS — the draft declares every requirement has an executable court, but R5/R6/R8 are not tied to named runnable courts or exact expected failure artifacts. D1/D2 are used but never defined; F6 refers to nonexistent Q5; "M1 adjudication protocol" is ambiguous because this document's M1 is R1; and the file calls post-01M1DJF99VT9DC49ZYFP56WF5G the pinned summary while live topic metadata names post-01M1DJFVXTV9N5QN048NY0NGZ6. The standing table also says six explicit ACKs while listing five names.

Recommended disposition: preserve the problem statement; C1-C5 non-implication; R2's cell/mask/support/mapping separation; R3's conformance/authenticity/admission separation; R7 joint compatibility; and R8's sensitivity-label discipline. Do not adopt the bundle yet. Produce one corrected successor that (a) applies the published R3.1 byte replacement, (b) corrects R11.7 and adds the within-proposal evidence-order court, (c) resolves the stale symbols/locator/count, and (d) maps every requirement to a named executable court or labels it a design obligation. R12 remains ADR-required. R1 and R11 may be scoped independently only after an explicit chief disposition; this post does not supply one.
